name: CRM - Konversi Lead per Cabang
query:
SELECT
    x.unit AS "Unit:Data:220",
    x.total_leads AS "Total Leads:Int:120",
    x.terdaftar AS "Terdaftar:Int:120",
    CONCAT(REPLACE(CAST(x.konversi AS CHAR), '.', ','), '%%') AS "Konversi:Data:110"
FROM (
    SELECT nama_unit AS unit, 0 AS sortkey,
        COUNT(*) AS total_leads,
        SUM(status_lead='Terdaftar') AS terdaftar,
        ROUND(100*SUM(status_lead='Terdaftar')/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS konversi
    FROM `tabRumba Lead`
    WHERE tanggal_lead BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    GROUP BY nama_unit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'TOTAL (gabungan)' AS unit, 1 AS sortkey,
        COUNT(*) AS total_leads,
        SUM(status_lead='Terdaftar') AS terdaftar,
        ROUND(100*SUM(status_lead='Terdaftar')/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS konversi
    FROM `tabRumba Lead`
    WHERE tanggal_lead BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
) x
ORDER BY x.sortkey, x.unit

name: Pembayaran Peserta Event
query:
SELECT
  p.parent AS "Event:Link/Rumba Event:120",
  ev.judul_event AS "Judul Event:Data:180",
  p.nama_murid AS "Nama:Data:150",
  p.unit_murid AS "Unit:Link/Rumba Unit:130",
  p.sales_invoice AS "Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:150",
  p.status_pembayaran AS "Status Bayar:Data:110",
  si.grand_total AS "Tagihan:Currency:110",
  si.outstanding_amount AS "Sisa:Currency:110",
  si.due_date AS "Jatuh Tempo:Date:110",
  CASE WHEN si.outstanding_amount > 0 AND si.due_date < CURDATE() THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) ELSE 0 END AS "Umur Tunggakan (hari):Int:130"
FROM `tabRumba Event Peserta` p
INNER JOIN `tabRumba Event` ev ON ev.name = p.parent
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = p.sales_invoice AND si.docstatus = 1
WHERE p.parenttype = 'Rumba Event' AND ev.berbayar = 1
ORDER BY si.due_date

name: Alumni
Rekap Kehadiran Murid
query:
SELECT
    p.murid AS "Murid:Link/Rumba Murid:150",
    m.nama_lengkap AS "Nama:Data:170",
    k.nama_unit AS "Unit:Link/Rumba Unit:140",
    SUM(p.status_kehadiran='Hadir') AS "Hadir:Int:70",
    SUM(p.status_kehadiran='Izin') AS "Izin:Int:70",
    SUM(p.status_kehadiran='Sakit') AS "Sakit:Int:70",
    SUM(p.status_kehadiran='Alpa') AS "Alpa:Int:70",
    COUNT(*) AS "Total Sesi:Int:90",
    CONCAT(REPLACE(CAST(ROUND(100*SUM(p.status_kehadiran='Hadir')/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS CHAR),'.',','),'%%') AS "%% Hadir:Data:90"
FROM `tabRumba Presensi Murid` p
INNER JOIN `tabRumba Sesi Kelas` s ON s.name = p.parent
INNER JOIN `tabRumba Kelas` k ON k.name = s.kelas
LEFT JOIN `tabRumba Murid` m ON m.name = p.murid
WHERE s.workflow_state = 'Disetujui'
    AND s.tanggal_sesi BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY p.murid, m.nama_lengkap, k.nama_unit
ORDER BY m.nama_lengkap

name: Event - Ringkasan Pelaksanaan
query:
SELECT
    e.name AS "Event:Link/Rumba Event:130",
    e.judul_event AS "Judul:Data:200",
    e.status AS "Status:Data:140",
    DATE(e.tanggal_mulai) AS "Tanggal Mulai:Date:110",
    DATEDIFF(DATE(e.tanggal_mulai), CURDATE()) AS "H- (Hari):Int:90",
    DATE(e.batas_pendaftaran) AS "Batas Daftar:Date:110",
    COALESCE(p.total, 0) AS "Pendaftar:Int:100",
    CASE WHEN e.berbayar = 1 THEN COALESCE(p.lunas, 0) ELSE NULL END AS "Sudah Bayar:Int:110",
    CASE WHEN e.berbayar = 1 THEN COALESCE(p.total, 0) - COALESCE(p.lunas, 0) ELSE NULL END AS "Belum Bayar:Int:110",
    e.kuota AS "Kuota:Int:80",
    CASE WHEN e.kuota > 0 THEN e.kuota - COALESCE(p.total, 0) ELSE NULL END AS "Sisa Kuota:Int:100",
    e.total_pendapatan AS "Pendapatan:Currency:130",
    e.total_pengeluaran AS "Pengeluaran:Currency:130",
    e.surplus_defisit AS "Surplus/Defisit:Currency:130"
FROM `tabRumba Event` e
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT parent,
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_pembayaran = 'Lunas' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lunas
    FROM `tabRumba Event Peserta`
    WHERE parenttype = 'Rumba Event' AND status_kehadiran != 'Batal'
    GROUP BY parent
) p ON p.parent = e.name
ORDER BY FIELD(e.status, 'Berlangsung', 'Pendaftaran Dibuka', 'Pendaftaran Ditutup', 'Draf', 'Selesai', 'Dibatalkan'), e.tanggal_mulai DESC

name: Rekap Event Tahunan
query:
SELECT
  YEAR(ev.tanggal_mulai) AS "Tahun:Int:80",
  ev.jenis_event AS "Jenis Event:Data:170",
  COUNT(*) AS "Jumlah Event:Int:110",
  SUM(ev.jumlah_peserta) AS "Total Peserta:Int:110",
  SUM(ev.total_pendapatan) AS "Pendapatan:Currency:130",
  SUM(ev.total_pengeluaran) AS "Pengeluaran:Currency:130",
  SUM(ev.surplus_defisit) AS "Surplus/Defisit:Currency:140"
FROM `tabRumba Event` ev
WHERE ev.status != 'Dibatalkan'
GROUP BY YEAR(ev.tanggal_mulai), ev.jenis_event
ORDER BY YEAR(ev.tanggal_mulai) DESC, ev.jenis_event

name: Rekap Izin & Penggantian Tutor
query:
SELECT

  s.guru AS "Tutor Asli:Link/Employee:220",

name: Peta Pemakaian Ruang & Guru
query:
SELECT
  r.nama_unit AS "Unit:Link/Rumba Unit:150",
  r.nama_ruangan AS "Ruang:Data:120",
  s.jam AS "Jam:Data:105",
  GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN k.senin=1 THEN CONCAT(k.nama_kelas, IF(IFNULL(k.wali_kelas,'')='', ' ⚠', CONCAT(' — ', IFNULL(e.employee_name, k.wali_kelas)))) END SEPARATOR ' / ') AS "Senin:Data:165",
  GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN k.selasa=1 THEN CONCAT(k.nama_kelas, IF(IFNULL(k.wali_kelas,'')='', ' ⚠', CONCAT(' — ', IFNULL(e.employee_name, k.wali_kelas)))) END SEPARATOR ' / ') AS "Selasa:Data:165",
  GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN k.rabu=1 THEN CONCAT(k.nama_kelas, IF(IFNULL(k.wali_kelas,'')='', ' ⚠', CONCAT(' — ', IFNULL(e.employee_name, k.wali_kelas)))) END SEPARATOR ' / ') AS "Rabu:Data:165",
  GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN k.kamis=1 THEN CONCAT(k.nama_kelas, IF(IFNULL(k.wali_kelas,'')='', ' ⚠', CONCAT(' — ', IFNULL(e.employee_name, k.wali_kelas)))) END SEPARATOR ' / ') AS "Kamis:Data:165",
  GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN k.jumat=1 THEN CONCAT(k.nama_kelas, IF(IFNULL(k.wali_kelas,'')='', ' ⚠', CONCAT(' — ', IFNULL(e.employee_name, k.wali_kelas)))) END SEPARATOR ' / ') AS "Jumat:Data:165",
  GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN k.sabtu=1 THEN CONCAT(k.nama_kelas, IF(IFNULL(k.wali_kelas,'')='', ' ⚠', CONCAT(' — ', IFNULL(e.employee_name, k.wali_kelas)))) END SEPARATOR ' / ') AS "Sabtu:Data:165"
FROM `tabRumba Ruangan` r
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT '09.30 - 10.45' AS jam UNION ALL SELECT '11.00 - 12.15' UNION ALL SELECT '12.30 - 13.45'
  UNION ALL SELECT '14.00 - 15.15' UNION ALL SELECT '15.30 - 16.45' UNION ALL SELECT '17.00 - 18.15'
  UNION ALL SELECT '18.45 - 20.00'
) s
LEFT JOIN `tabRumba Kelas` k ON k.nama_ruangan = r.name AND k.jam_belajar = s.jam AND k.status_kelas = 'Aktif'
LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` e ON e.name = k.wali_kelas
WHERE r.status_ruangan = 'Aktif'
GROUP BY r.name, s.jam
ORDER BY r.nama_unit, r.nama_ruangan, s.jam

name: Rekap Jam Mengajar (F-GAJ-01)
query:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN s.status_sesi='Diganti' AND s.guru_pengganti IS NOT NULL AND s.guru_pengganti<>'' THEN s.guru_pengganti ELSE s.guru END AS "Guru:Link/Employee:160",
    k.program_belajar AS "Program:Link/Rumba Program Belajar:150",

name: Piutang SPP per Unit (Aging)
query:
SELECT
    si.rumba_unit AS "Unit:Link/Rumba Unit:140",
    si.rumba_murid AS "Murid:Link/Rumba Murid:150",
    si.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:170",
    si.spp_periode AS "Periode SPP:Data:90",
    si.name AS "Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:150",
    si.due_date AS "Jatuh Tempo:Date:100",
    si.outstanding_amount AS "Outstanding:Currency:120",
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) AS "Umur (hari):Int:90",
    CASE
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) < 0 THEN 'Belum jatuh tempo'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) <= 6 THEN 'Pantau (H+0-6)'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) <= 13 THEN 'Pengingat 1 (H+7)'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) <= 20 THEN 'Pengingat 2 (H+14)'
        ELSE 'Eskalasi (H+21)'
    END AS "Tahap (SOP-FIN-009):Data:160"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.outstanding_amount > 0
ORDER BY si.rumba_unit ASC, si.due_date ASC

name: Pemasaran - Efektivitas Kanal
query:
SELECT
    x.kanal AS "Kanal:Data:200",
    x.leads AS "Lead:Int:80",
    x.trial AS "Trial:Int:80",
    x.terdaftar AS "Terdaftar:Int:100",
    CONCAT(REPLACE(CAST(ROUND(x.terdaftar * 100.0 / NULLIF(x.leads, 0), 1) AS CHAR), '.', ','), '%%') AS "Konversi:Data:100",
    x.biaya AS "Biaya:Currency:140",
    ROUND(x.biaya / NULLIF(x.leads, 0)) AS "CPL (Biaya/Lead):Currency:150",
    ROUND(x.biaya / NULLIF(x.terdaftar, 0)) AS "CAC (Biaya/Murid):Currency:150"
FROM (
    SELECT 0 AS sortkey, 1 AS urut, 'Kunjungan Sekolah' AS kanal,
        COUNT(*) AS leads,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tanggal_trial IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trial,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_lead = 'Terdaftar' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terdaftar,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.biaya),0) FROM `tabRumba Aktivitas Pemasaran` a WHERE a.kanal='Kunjungan Sekolah' AND a.tanggal BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s) AS biaya
    FROM `tabRumba Lead`
    WHERE (sekolah = 1) AND tanggal_lead BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 0 AS sortkey, 2 AS urut, 'Event RUMBA' AS kanal,
        COUNT(*) AS leads,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tanggal_trial IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trial,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_lead = 'Terdaftar' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terdaftar,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.biaya),0) FROM `tabRumba Aktivitas Pemasaran` a WHERE a.kanal='Event RUMBA' AND a.tanggal BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.jumlah),0) FROM `tabRumba Event Pengeluaran` p JOIN `tabRumba Event` e ON p.parent = e.name AND p.parenttype = 'Rumba Event' WHERE DATE(e.tanggal_mulai) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s) AS biaya
    FROM `tabRumba Lead`
    WHERE (kegiatan_rumba = 1) AND tanggal_lead BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 0 AS sortkey, 3 AS urut, 'Online (IG/FB/Web/Cari)' AS kanal,
        COUNT(*) AS leads,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tanggal_trial IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trial,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_lead = 'Terdaftar' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terdaftar,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.biaya),0) FROM `tabRumba Aktivitas Pemasaran` a WHERE a.kanal='Online' AND a.tanggal BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s) AS biaya
    FROM `tabRumba Lead`
    WHERE (instagram = 1 OR facebook = 1 OR website_bimbelrumba = 1 OR pencarian_di_internet = 1) AND tanggal_lead BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 0 AS sortkey, 4 AS urut, 'Rujukan (Kawan/Keluarga)' AS kanal,
        COUNT(*) AS leads,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tanggal_trial IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trial,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_lead = 'Terdaftar' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terdaftar,
        0 AS biaya
    FROM `tabRumba Lead`
    WHERE (kawan = 1 OR keluarga = 1) AND tanggal_lead BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 0 AS sortkey, 5 AS urut, 'Spanduk/Brosur' AS kanal,
        COUNT(*) AS leads,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tanggal_trial IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trial,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_lead = 'Terdaftar' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terdaftar,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.biaya),0) FROM `tabRumba Aktivitas Pemasaran` a WHERE a.kanal='Spanduk/Brosur' AND a.tanggal BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s) AS biaya
    FROM `tabRumba Lead`
    WHERE (spanduk_di_jalan = 1 OR brosur_selebaran = 1) AND tanggal_lead BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 0 AS sortkey, 6 AS urut, 'Lainnya' AS kanal,
        COUNT(*) AS leads,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tanggal_trial IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trial,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_lead = 'Terdaftar' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terdaftar,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.biaya),0) FROM `tabRumba Aktivitas Pemasaran` a WHERE a.kanal='Lainnya' AND a.tanggal BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s) AS biaya
    FROM `tabRumba Lead`
    WHERE (lainnya = 1) AND tanggal_lead BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 0 AS sortkey, 7 AS urut, '(Tanpa Sumber Tercatat)' AS kanal,
        COUNT(*) AS leads,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tanggal_trial IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trial,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_lead = 'Terdaftar' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terdaftar,
        0 AS biaya
    FROM `tabRumba Lead`
    WHERE (instagram = 0 AND facebook = 0 AND website_bimbelrumba = 0 AND pencarian_di_internet = 0 AND kawan = 0 AND keluarga = 0 AND sekolah = 0 AND kegiatan_rumba = 0 AND spanduk_di_jalan = 0 AND brosur_selebaran = 0 AND lainnya = 0) AND tanggal_lead BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 1 AS sortkey, 99 AS urut, 'TOTAL (lead unik)' AS kanal,
        COUNT(*) AS leads,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tanggal_trial IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trial,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_lead = 'Terdaftar' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terdaftar,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.biaya),0) FROM `tabRumba Aktivitas Pemasaran` a WHERE a.tanggal BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.jumlah),0) FROM `tabRumba Event Pengeluaran` p JOIN `tabRumba Event` e ON p.parent = e.name AND p.parenttype = 'Rumba Event' WHERE DATE(e.tanggal_mulai) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s) AS biaya
    FROM `tabRumba Lead`
    WHERE tanggal_lead BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
) x
ORDER BY x.sortkey, x.urut

name: Kemitraan - Nilai Pipeline
query:
SELECT
    x.status AS "Tahap:Data:200",
    x.jumlah AS "Jumlah Prospek:Int:140",
    x.total_fee AS "Total Franchise Fee:Currency:200"
FROM (
    SELECT 0 AS sortkey,
        FIELD(status_mitra,'Baru','Dikualifikasi','Presentasi','Due Diligence','Negosiasi','Perjanjian','Deal','Tidak Jadi') AS urut,
        status_mitra AS status,
        COUNT(*) AS jumlah,
        SUM(COALESCE(franchise_fee, 0)) AS total_fee
    FROM `tabRumba Mitra Lead`
    WHERE tanggal_prospek BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    GROUP BY status_mitra
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1, 98, 'TOTAL PIPELINE AKTIF', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(franchise_fee, 0)), 0)
    FROM `tabRumba Mitra Lead`
    WHERE tanggal_prospek BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
      AND status_mitra NOT IN ('Deal', 'Tidak Jadi')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1, 99, 'FEE TEREALISASI (DEAL)', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(franchise_fee, 0)), 0)
    FROM `tabRumba Mitra Lead`
    WHERE tanggal_prospek BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
      AND status_mitra = 'Deal'
) x
ORDER BY x.sortkey, x.urut

name: Kemitraan - Funnel Mitra
query:
SELECT
    x.status AS "Tahap:Data:180",
    x.jumlah AS "Jumlah Prospek:Int:140",
    x.keterangan AS "Keterangan:Data:240"
FROM (
    SELECT 0 AS sortkey,
        FIELD(status_mitra,'Baru','Dikualifikasi','Presentasi','Due Diligence','Negosiasi','Perjanjian','Deal','Tidak Jadi') AS urut,
        status_mitra AS status,
        COUNT(*) AS jumlah,
        CONCAT(REPLACE(CAST(ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabRumba Mitra Lead` t WHERE t.tanggal_prospek BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s), 0), 1) AS CHAR), '.', ','), '%% dari total') AS keterangan
    FROM `tabRumba Mitra Lead`
    WHERE tanggal_prospek BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    GROUP BY status_mitra
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1, 99, 'TOTAL PROSPEK', COUNT(*),
        CONCAT('Konversi Deal: ', REPLACE(CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status_mitra = 'Deal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS CHAR), '.', ','), '%%')
    FROM `tabRumba Mitra Lead`
    WHERE tanggal_prospek BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
) x
ORDER BY x.sortkey, x.urut

name: Profitabilitas Event

  ev.judul_event AS "Judul Event:Data:200",
  ev.jenis_event AS "Jenis:Data:130",
  ev.status AS "Status:Data:120",
  ev.tanggal_mulai AS "Tanggal Mulai:Datetime:150",
  ev.jumlah_peserta AS "Peserta:Int:80",
  ev.total_pendapatan AS "Pendapatan:Currency:120",

name: Presensi di Luar Lokasi
query:
SELECT

  ec.time AS "Waktu:Datetime:160",
  ec.log_type AS "Jenis:Data:70",
  ec.rumba_status_lokasi AS "Status Lokasi:Data:120",
  ec.rumba_jarak_meter AS "Jarak (m):Int:90",

name: Rekap Bintang Murid
query:
SELECT
    b.murid AS "Murid:Link/Rumba Murid:160",
    b.nama_murid AS "Nama:Data:180",
    m.program_belajar AS "Program:Link/Rumba Program Belajar:150",
    m.nama_unit AS "Unit:Link/Rumba Unit:140",
    COUNT(*) AS "Jumlah Sesi:Int:100",
    COALESCE(SUM(b.bintang),0) AS "Total Bintang:Int:110"
FROM `tabRumba BKM Entry` b
INNER JOIN `tabRumba Murid` m ON m.name = b.murid
WHERE b.workflow_state = 'Disetujui'
    AND b.tanggal_sesi BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY b.murid, b.nama_murid, m.program_belajar, m.nama_unit
ORDER BY 6 DESC

name: Pengunduran Diri Murid

    kategori AS "Kategori:Data:90",
    tanggal_pemberitahuan AS "Diberitahu:Date:100",
    tanggal_efektif AS "Efektif:Date:100",
    notice_terpenuhi AS "Notice H-14:Check:90",

name: Daftar Tunggu (FIFO)
query:

    nama_calon AS "Nama Calon:Data:160",
    nomor_handphone AS "No. HP:Data:120",

name: Riwayat Ujian Kenaikan Level
query:
SELECT
    u.name AS "Ujian:Link/Rumba Ujian Kenaikan Level:140",
    u.tanggal_ujian AS "Tanggal:Date:100",
    u.murid AS "Murid:Link/Rumba Murid:130",
    m.nama_lengkap AS "Nama:Data:170",
    m.nama_unit AS "Unit:Link/Rumba Unit:140",
    u.program AS "Program:Data:130",
    u.level_diuji AS "Level Diuji:Data:100",
    e.employee_name AS "Penguji:Data:160",
    u.hasil AS "Hasil:Data:100",
    u.status_ujian AS "Status:Data:80"
FROM `tabRumba Ujian Kenaikan Level` u
INNER JOIN `tabRumba Murid` m ON m.name = u.murid
LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` e ON e.name = u.penguji
WHERE u.tanggal_ujian BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY u.tanggal_ujian DESC, u.name DESC
